_readme: UCT Setup Vocabulary v1 — the ONE setup-name authority (D9; W1 §3.2; CONTRACTS §6.2). Built from setup-vocabulary-v0.draft.json under the owner's W1 §3 rulings; api/services/wisdom/core/vocab.py seeds wisdom_vocab and wisdom_vocab_maps from this file and nothing else.

STATUS (W1 §3.1): the 32 v0 candidates are the approved working list. evidence_strength 'thin' (one passing use) stays a candidate until a second independent source appears; every other entry is approved. status_reason names the rule that applied. Owner coinages carry coined_by 'tsdr' (W1 §3.5).

MAPS (W1 §3.2): every name in the six existing lists, every pattern-engine detector id, and the ENGINE setup strings has a row. vocab_id null means the list names something the vocabulary does not; that is recorded, not hidden. mismatch 1 means mapped, but the list's name or definition differs from the vocabulary entry (the four W1 §3.3 mismatches, plus approximate mappings); no rename happens in W1.

THE RAIL: tests/test_wisdom_vocab_authority.py derives every setup-name constant from the CI-derivable lists and fails BY NAME on a name with no row, a row whose name no longer exists, or a row naming an unknown vocab_id. The ENGINE lists are not in this repository; re-measure them with tools/wisdom/core_vocab_engine_check.py --engine-db <path>.

PUBLIC REPOSITORY (W1 §0.4f): this file carries no source text. definition is null; every evidence item is a locator (stream, source_ref, section or cue); aliases are name-like forms of at most three words with no price level. Definition text, excerpts and paraphrases stay in gitignored data/wisdom/: many Sunday Scans excerpts are golden-set text, and a public copy would contaminate the golden gate.
ambiguous_aliases lists alias spellings that two entries share; vocab.lookup resolves them to nothing rather than choosing.
